messages:
ops_lead: Postmortem for INC-2027 live. Root cause: KV cache evictions during burst encodes -> downstream latency. We need concrete follow-ups: runbook triage refinement, playbook commands, alert tuning, and owner + ETA for each. Please volunteer. Link: https://redwood.in/p/INC-2027

maria: I can take runbook edits. Will add step-by-step triage commands, clear thresholds, and an escalation flow. ETA: Tue EOD.

ajay: I'll own autoscaler/headroom remediation and add canary config. Will attach repro metrics and a PR by Fri.

sasha: I'll update alerts to reduce noisy paging and add a weekly aggregation to flag recurring patterns.

devon: Dropped a quick triage snippet in the temp doc, @maria pls incorporate.

```bash
# quick triage checklist
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=15m | grep -i eviction
redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human
curl -s 'http://metrics/api/v1/query?query=rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])'
```

maria: Good stuff. I'll also add an explicit fallback trigger: POST /v1/deployments/{id}/fallback and the exact notification template for oncall.

sam: I'll prototype a cache pre-warm job that runs before known burst windows. Filing INC-2027-FW-3 and linking.

incident-bot: INC-2027 follow-ups created: INC-2027-FW (parent). Reminders set for owners.

ops_lead: Parent Jira INC-2027-FW created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2027-FW. Add sub-tasks and link PRs. Weekly status updates until closure.

kelly: Suggest runbook threshold: "if eviction_rate > 0.4% over 5m AND p50 > 250ms, escalate to oncall@redwood.ai and run fallback." I'll add this to the Jira comment.

maria: Adding that threshold and a 1-click checklist (commands, rollback snippet, who to page). Will include mini-diagram for escalation path.

ajay: Found same pattern in two older incidents; adding cross-incident note in playbook to always verify autoscaler headroom + model variant fallbacks.

ops_lead: Good. Please tag this thread when you push PRs. Check-in on next Wed standup; update Jira before then. :calendar: :thumbsup:

sasha: ack :thumbsup:

maria: will tag PRs when open.

sam: cache-warm task linked to parent ticket. Prototype ETA next sprint.

ops_lead: Thanks all  keep close on recurrence patterns so we reduce repeat toil.
